title: use-after-free in bytearray search-like methods
object: the bytearray's storage, cached as PyByteArray_AS_STRING(self)
lifetime_ender: user code resizes the bytearray, and the REALLOC moves the block
distinguishing: the only case in the corpus whose block is ended by a realloc rather than a free. The driver ASSERTS the realloc moved the block; a realloc that returned the same address would leave it testing nothing
size_note: the storage is pymalloc's only while the bytearray is small; a large one falls through to malloc, where ASan sees the same defect. The driver pins 48 bytes growing to 300, both below the threshold
live_proof: back-patched into the 3.13 branch after v3.13.7
